method: Reads selected recent ASX announcement PDFs for leading candidates and core holdings. Detects guidance, capital raising/dilution, debt/liquidity, cash burn, capex, customer concentration, contracts and execution evidence, plus sector-specific disclosure snippets. Evidence is heuristic and retained with source document metadata for auditability.
